fichas.title: Storey heights and building services
fichas.summary: Compares office storey heights according to installation requirements, from low-installation buildings without suspended ceilings to air-conditioned offices with ceiling voids and corridor ducts. A separate example describes a 3.00 m ceiling height requiring a taller storey to accommodate crossing ventilation ducts.
uses: Routing ventilation ducts, cables, heating and water pipework

fichas.title: Alternatives to conventional office air conditioning
fichas.summary: Illustrates alternatives using the bare ceiling slab as a heat buffer, including night-time cooling, underfloor convectors, and cooling convectors in cupboards. The text discusses energy use, thermal regulation, and the relationship between air-conditioned building volume and construction costs.
uses: Using building elements as heat buffers
Reducing energy consumption and service cross-sections

dimensions.context: The text compares air-conditioned buildings with buildings without air conditioning.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The gross built volume and the total construction costs for air-conditioned buildings are 1 .3-1 .5 times higher than for buildings without air conditioning
